/Instagram)

title: Shopify Operations & Quality Control VA
description:
Location: Remote 



Role Overview

We're a fast-growing fashion e-commerce business operating multiple stores in the US market. Building out our QC and inventory ops function and need a sharp, detail-oriented VA to own it. You'll work closely with our China-based supplier agent — reviewing inspection reports, setting and enforcing quality standards, holding the supply chain accountable. On inventory: track sales, manage reorder points, keep the right products in stock. Not a passive coordination role — we move fast and need someone who takes ownership, flags problems early, and brings structure.



Responsibilities



A — QC Coordination with China Agent:

- Define and maintain written quality standards per product category (materials, construction, finish, measurements, packaging)

- Review pre-shipment inspection reports and photos from the China agent

- Approve or reject batches against defined standards, with documented reasoning

- Follow up on defects — root cause, corrective action, supplier accountability

- Maintain defect log and quality tracker across all suppliers and products

- Flag recurring quality issues and escalate with recommendations



B — Inventory & Data Ops:

- Track sales velocity and return rates by product across all stores

- Maintain reorder-point models and flag approaching thresholds

- Coordinate POs with the China agent based on demand signals

- Analyze returns to separate quality vs sizing vs expectation

- Produce weekly quality + inventory summary reports



Requirements



Must-have:

- Strong written + verbal English — you'll write standards, review reports, communicate decisions

- Comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel for tracking and analysis

- Experience reviewing supplier inspection reports and photos

- Detail-oriented with strong follow-through

- Comfortable making QC approve/reject judgment calls

- Experience working with overseas suppliers or agents

- Background in women's fashion or apparel

- 3PL setup or management exposure



Nice-to-have:

- Shopify experience



Tools & Systems

Google Sheets, Shopify, Slack, Notion or Google Docs,
 + WhatsApp for supplier agent coordination.



Compensation

As agreed.



We review every application carefully. If this sounds like your kind of role, apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph — thoughtful applicants only.

title: Storyboard Artist for 3D Animated YouTube Shorts (Long-term, Zack D Films Style)
description:
I run a growing 3D animated faceless YouTube channel modeled on Zack D Films, and I'm hiring a long-term storyboard artist who is the bridge between the script and the final animated short. This is the most important hire on my team — the storyboard is what makes or breaks the video.



Main Responsibility — Storyboarding (60% of your time)

For every approved script you receive, you'll break it down into small sentences (one beat per frame) and turn it into a storyboard. For each sentence you'll provide:



A clear visual instruction (camera angle, character action, expression, environment)

A reference image (a screenshot from a similar Zack D Films short, a movie still, or a real photo — anything that shows the animator exactly what you mean)

Timing notes if the beat needs special pacing (slow zoom, hard cut, hold-for-laugh)

A 3D animator should be able to open your storyboard, look at sentence #14, and animate that frame without asking you a single question.



Voiceover Production (15%)

Use Elevenlabs to create the voice over then use Audacity to trim the VoiceOver with fullstops, etc.



Animator Feedback Loop (15%)

Once the 3D animators deliver a draft, you review it against the storyboard. If something is off — wrong camera angle, off timing, expression doesn't match the line — you write clear revision notes with timestamps and (where useful) annotated screenshots. You keep this loop running until the final video matches our quality bar.



Channel Management (10%)



Upload finished videos to YouTube with the right title, description, tags, thumbnail

Schedule uploads on our posting cadence

Reply to comments to drive engagement (you'll be given a tone guide)

Flag comments that need my attention (sponsorships, collabs, complaints)

You'll be given on Day 1: Full Zack D Films scripting SOP, reverse-engineered storyboard reference Zack D Films shorts, animator brief + revision-note templates, channel SOP, voiceover sample reels.



? BIG PLUS — 3D Animation Skills (Higher Pay)

If you can also do 3D animation (Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or similar), this is a major plus. I'll send 3D animation work your way on top of the storyboarding role, and your monthly salary goes up accordingly — see the salary breakdown below. If you're a strong storyboard artist AND a competent 3D animator, you're exactly who I want on this team long-term.



Who You Are:



You've worked on at least one animated YouTube channel before (unpaid passion projects count if the work is good)

Strong visual sense — when you read "he slowly opened the door," you immediately picture the angle, lighting, and lens

Clear, natural-sounding English. Voice samples required

You read briefs carefully and ask clarifying questions early instead of guessing

Available for one 30-minute video call per week

Can commit 6+ months. No 1-month contracts

What this job is NOT: You will not be writing scripts (we have a scriptwriter). You will not be doing the 3D animation (we have animators). You will not be designing thumbnails (we have a thumbnail designer). You will be the bridge between script and animation. That's the whole job.



HOW TO APPLY — follow this format exactly:



1. Start your message with the words "Frame 14" so I know you read the full post.

2. Portfolio: 1–3 links to storyboards or animated shorts you've worked on. If you don't have public examples, paste a 10-frame storyboard for this sentence: "I broke my brother's trophy and tried to hide it before he got home — but then I heard his key in the lock." Use any image references you want (Google Image links are fine).

3. Voice sample: A 30–60 second voiceover recording. Drive/Dropbox link, no attachments.

4. Zack D Films question: In 2–3 sentences, what makes a Zack D Films short work? What's the one thing he does that most copycat channels miss?

5. Availability: Your timezone, hours/week you can commit, and earliest start date.

Applications that don't follow this format will be ignored. I'm hiring for attention to detail — your application is the first test.

title: Senior Personal Injury Case Manager (100k+ Settlements & Paralegal Demand Experience)

Department: Pre-Suit | Plaintiff Personal Injury

Reports To: Managing Attorney



About the Role

We are a fast growing, results oriented Plaintiff Personal Injury law firm seeking a highly experienced Senior Case Manager to step into a high responsibility role. You will manage high value personal injury cases from intake through settlement and close out. You will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, coordinating medical treatment, managing complex insurance claims, preparing polished demand packages, and ensuring strict compliance with all deadlines.



We are looking for a true professional who thrives in a fast paced remote environment, communicates directly, and can manage a high volume of details without dropping the ball. If you are just looking to coast, this is not the job for you. If you are driven by results, value clear systems, and want to be rewarded for your hard work, we want to talk to you.



Key Responsibilities

Client Communication & Case Management:

• Serve as the primary client contact via phone,
, text, and client portal.

• Onboard new clients and clearly set expectations from day one.

• Provide regular case updates with empathy and professionalism.

• Maintain organized, highly detailed case notes and next actions in our case management system.



Insurance Claims & Coverage:

• Open and aggressively manage Bodily Injury, MedPay/PIP (if applicable), and UM/UIM claims.

• Rapidly obtain declarations pages, policy limits, and adjuster information.

• Request, track, and file UM/UIM Selection or Rejection Letters for applicable policies.

• Ensure complete and timely coverage verification for every file.



Deadlines & Compliance:

• Calendar and meticulously track California deadlines, including the 2 year statute of limitations and municipal/ante litem notice deadlines.

• Maintain a standard of zero missed deadlines and perfectly accurate documentation.



Medical Treatment & Records:

• Coordinate medical provider referrals under attorney direction.

• Monitor treatment progress and MMI status.

• Request, track, and strictly quality check HIPAA compliant medical records and bills.



Liens & Subrogation:

• Open and tightly manage Medicaid, Medicare, ERISA, and private health insurance liens.

• Obtain final lien demands and assist with aggressive reductions.



Demands, Settlement & Close Out:

• Prepare highly polished demand packages, including liability summaries, damages narratives, medical specials spreadsheets, and supporting exhibits.

• Support settlement negotiations for high value cases under attorney supervision.

• Process settlements, releases, disbursements, and case close out checklists.



Performance Metrics (KPIs):

We use KPI tracking to reward high performers with bonuses, not for micromanagement. You will be measured on:

• Time from assignment to demand and settlement.

• Coverage completeness (UM/UIM letters and verified limits secured within 30 days).

• Medical records turnaround time and first pass completeness.

• Zero missed deadlines and clean CRM documentation.

• Time Zone Integrity: Strict adherence to 9 AM - 6 PM Pacific Time. You must be actively online, responsive, and working solely for our firm during these hours.



Qualifications:

• Proven plaintiff personal injury pre-suit case management experience.

• California PI experience is strongly preferred (or a rigorous willingness to learn CA specific rules).

• Deep working knowledge of UM/UIM, MedPay/PIP, medical billing terminology, and complex liens/subrogation.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

• Highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and tech savvy.

• Prior experience working effectively in a fast paced environment.

• Reliable, professional, and comfortable working completely independently in a remote setting.



Technology & Tools

• Experience with at least one major PI case management system (Filevine, Needles, SmartAdvocate, Lead Docket).

• Comfortable with Microsoft 365.

• Familiar with e-fax, e-signature tools, and VOIP systems.

(Training is provided for firm specific tools.)



Compensation & Benefits:

• $2,500 USD Monthly, paid bi-weekly. Negotiable depending on experience.

• 40 hour work week from 9 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time.

• Aggressive performance bonuses tied to KPIs (Up to $1,000 USD).

• Full time, long term position.

• An efficient team environment with well defined processes, direct collaboration with a U.S. attorney, and major opportunities for growth.



Why Join Our Firm

• Stable, long term remote role (not project based)

• Direct collaboration with U.S. attorney

• Well defined processes and realistic expectations

• Opportunity to grow with a plaintiff side personal injury practice



How to Apply:

To prove you have read this entire job description, you must start your application or
 subject line with the exact phrase: "California PI Closer - [Your Name]". Applications without this subject line will be immediately archived.



Workspace & Application Requirements:

To support a successful remote work environment and ensure you are set up for long term success, applicants MUST include the following in their proposal:

• A short Loom video introduction (2-3 minutes max). In this video, you MUST verbally answer Question #4 (The Furious Client scenario). Show us exactly how you would speak to this client to de-escalate the situation.

• A brief view of your dedicated workspace.

• A screenshot confirming your internet speed (Minimum: 50 Mbps Download) and computer specifications (Minimum: 8GB RAM, i5 processor or equivalent).

(These materials help us ensure long term success in a fully remote role.)

Each day you’ll post content across several subreddits.



A critical part of this role is reading the room. The videos we provide can range from humorous to emotional to awkward or uncomfortable. You need to instantly recognize the tone and write posts that feel natural for that type of content. If you post everything the same way, you’ll fail.



You’ll also be responsible for finding appropriate subreddits for each video. That means reviewing community rules, understanding what performs well there, and making sure your post doesn’t look forced or out of place. If you can’t do that consistently, this position isn’t for you.

This is a weekly recurring role. The voice IS the brand on a faceless channel — so I'm looking for someone I can lock in for the long haul, not a one-off freelancer. 

About the Channel:

Niche: Old-school bodybuilding history, Golden Era training methods, fitness mythology

Style: Faceless / narration-driven storytelling

Reference voices I want to match:

Documentary narrator delivery (think the History Channel "Modern Marvels" style)

Joe Rogan's storytelling tone (without the laugh)

Magnates Media narrator (calm authority + dramatic punch)

The Voice I'm Looking For:

? Neutral American accent — must sound 100% natural to a US/global audience

? Deep to mid-range masculine tone — not too high, not too gravelly

? Dramatic range — must be able to whisper a line, then deliver impact on the next

? Confident pacing — comfortable with strategic pauses and emphasis

? Storyteller energy — not a "radio announcer" or "corporate explainer" voice

?? Voices that won't be a fit:

Heavy Filipino accent traces (especially on "th" sounds, short vowels)

Overly young / "podcast bro" energy

Monotone or "audiobook narrator" delivery

Anyone who reads scripts robotically without emotion

What You'll Be Doing Each Week:You'll receive:

A finished script (1,500–1,800 words / ~9–12 min audio)

Inline direction notes 

Reference clips for tone alignment

Your deliverables:

WAV file, 48kHz, 24-bit (no MP3 — too compressed for editing)

Dry / unprocessed audio — no music, no reverb, no EQ (my editor handles post-production)

Recorded in a treated space — no echo, no background noise, no room hum

Delivered within 48–72 hours of receiving the script

One free revision included per video

Requirements:

? Minimum 1 year of professional voice over experience

? Home studio with proper acoustic treatment (no closet recordings)

? Quality microphone (Rode NT1, Shure SM7B, AT2020 or equivalent)

? Audio interface (Focusrite Scarlett or similar)

? Reliable internet for large WAV file transfers (Google Drive / Dropbox / WeTransfer)

? Excellent English comprehension (you must catch the nuance and drama in the script)

? Open to direction and revisions without ego

? Consistent voice across videos — same energy week after week

Compensation:

$50 USD per finished video to start (paid via Wise, PayPal, Cash App or your preference)

Pay increases as the channel grows — I commit to revisiting rates every 10 videos based on channel performance

Guaranteed weekly work once trial is complete

Bonus structure when videos hit view milestones

Trial Process:

Apply with audio samples + the test read below

Top 3 candidates get a paid full trial — record the first 90 seconds of a real script ($15 paid regardless of outcome)

Best read gets the full first video at standard rate

If the first video lands, we lock in a recurring weekly arrangement

REQUIRED TEST READ:Please record the following 35-second hook and submit it as part of your application. This is non-negotiable — I need to hear how you handle MY script, not a generic demo reel.

"You're scrolling through Instagram. Some influencer is telling you their new 'scientifically optimized' workout targets the upper-third of the lateral deltoid. He's got charts. He's got data. He's got a pantry that looks like a small pharmacy. But something's missing… isn't it?

Now look at this. The nineteen-seventies. Arnold. Franco. Ferrigno. That raw, thick, three-dimensional look — it feels like a lost art. It's the difference between a CGI explosion… and real dynamite."

Direction notes for the test read:

Open conversational, like you're talking to a friend

Slow down on "But something's missing… isn't it?" — let it land

Hit "real dynamite" with weight — that line should feel almost physical

Don't rush — the pauses are part of the delivery

To Apply, Send Me:

2–3 audio samples of previous narration work (YouTube videos preferred)

The required test read above (record fresh — don't send a generic demo)

Your weekly availability and turnaround time

Your sample rate/format defaults (confirm you can deliver 48kHz/24-bit WAV)

Applications without the test read will be ignored.

Why Work With Me:

I pay on time, every time (Wise/PayPal, cash app fast turnaround)

I give clear direction with inline script notes (no vague "more emotion" feedback)

I commit to long-term partnerships and growing rates with the channel

I respect your craft — you're the brand voice, not a commodity

This channel is going to be built around YOUR voice. Let's find out if you're the right fit.

title: Cold Caller for AI Startup (B2B / North America) - $3/hr + Bonuses
description:
Hi everyone, I'm Asad, founder of Avidra, a small AI startup based in Toronto, Canada. We're building an AI receptionist that answers calls for small trade businesses in North America (plumbers, HVAC techs, electricians) when the owner can't pick up.



I'm looking for a part-time outbound caller to help us reach our first 100 customers. This is long-term ongoing work, not a one-off gig. I want to find someone I can grow with.



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY:

- Make 80-100 outbound calls per shift using our pre-researched lead list

- Use our script and objection-handling guide (full training provided)

- Goal of every call: get permission to send our 2-minute demo video. NOT to close the sale. I close those myself afterward.

- Log every call in a Google Sheet (provided)

- Send a daily 5-minute screen recording with 2-3 actual call recordings and the common objections you heard



REQUIREMENTS:

- Strong, clear English with a neutral or North American accent. This is the most important one. Our customers are tradespeople in the US and Canada who hang up quickly on calls they cannot easily understand.

- 1+ year of B2B cold calling or outbound sales experience

- Experience with VOIP tools (we provide the account)

- Comfortable with Google Sheets and screen recording tools

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, decent headset

- 5 hours per day, Monday to Friday, 9 PM to 2 AM Manila Time (this is 9 AM to 2 PM Eastern Time, the strongest pickup window for tradespeople in North America)

- B2B outbound experience only. No real estate, insurance, or MLM.



COMPENSATION:

- $3 USD per hour base, paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

- $2 bonus per qualified lead (real business owner, real contact info, agreed to receive the demo)

- $20 bonus per paid customer who signs up from a lead you generated

- $10 retention bonus when that customer stays 60+ days



A solid caller with consistent conversion can land around $5-7 per hour effective rate once the bonuses are factored in.



I'll be straight with you: the base is on the lower end because we're early and bootstrapped. The bonuses are real and they're how I want this role to actually pay. If that math does not work for you, no hard feelings.



HIRE PROCESS:

1. Apply with the items below

2. 15-minute video interview if shortlisted

3. Paid 1-hour live trial ($3) where we run the script together. No free work.

4. 30-day paid probation

5. Long-term ongoing contract



WHAT I PROVIDE:

- Full script and objection-handling guide

- Pre-researched lead list with business info

- VOIP account with a North American number

- Company
 on our domain

- Standard time tracking



HOW TO APPLY:

1. A 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you (Vocaroo, SoundCloud, or any audio host works)

2. Your years of B2B cold calling experience and the specific industries you have called into

3. Your typical daily call volume in past roles

4. Your time zone in Manila Time and the shift hours you can work



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. I need to hear how you sound on a call before anything else.



Thanks for reading.



— Asad

title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry brand using AI influencers. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for short-form videos, character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — training provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen and virality-native illustrated character storytelling. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated. You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.

description:
Hey — quick intro before the details.



We're a DTC ecommerce brand running paid ads on
, Instagram, and TikTok. We're scaling our testing volume and need a reliable editor to help us turn scripts, UGC, and product footage into polished ads — consistently, week after week.

This isn't a one-off gig. If we work well together, this becomes ongoing weekly work with clear briefs, fast feedback, and room to grow as we scale spend.



What you'll be doing



Each week, you'll take our scripts, voiceovers, and raw footage, and turn them into ad creatives ready to run on paid social.

That includes:



Cutting new ads from supplied scripts + UGC, product, and B-roll footage

Creating 3-5 variations off our winners (new hooks, openers, CTAs)

Adding captions, overlays, B-roll inserts, SFX, music, and pattern interrupts

Matching the style and pacing of our top-performing ads (we'll share examples)

Delivering platform-ready files (9:16 for TikTok/Reels, 1:1 for Feed, etc.)

Handling revisions quickly — ideally within 24-48 hours



You won't be writing scripts or sourcing footage. We provide the brief, the assets, and clear direction. Your job is to execute the edit.



What we're looking for



Some experience editing ecommerce, UGC, or direct-response style ads (even a few examples is fine)

Comfortable in CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or similar

Understands the basics of ad pacing — hooks, fast cuts, captions, retention

Reliable communication and reasonable turnaround

Wants ongoing work, not just a one-off project



Bonus if you understand metrics like hook rate, hold rate, or CTR — but not required. We'll teach you what matters as we go.

What we provide



Scripts written for direct response

Voiceovers when needed

Raw UGC, product footage, and B-roll

Editing instructions and reference ads for every brief

Clear, specific feedback — no vague notes



What we offer



Consistent work — multiple ads per week, ongoing

Long-term collaboration — we'd rather build with one good editor than juggle five

Clear briefs — you'll always know what we want

Performance feedback — we'll tell you which edits won and why, so you sharpen over time

Rate growth — as we scale spend, top performers get more volume and better rates



How to apply

Send us:



2-3 examples of ad-style edits you've done (ecommerce, UGC, or DR — links are fine)

Your editing tool (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, etc.)

Typical turnaround for a 30-60 second ad with one round of revisions

Your rate — per ad, per hour, or per week (whatever you prefer)

A quick note on why ongoing ad editing work appeals to you



If your work and rate look like a fit, we'll send over a paid trial project — one real ad with full brief, footage, and script. It's how we confirm style, pacing, and communication match before committing to ongoing work. Editors who do well on the trial move straight into our weekly rotation.

title: Land Acquisitions VA — Discovery Calls & CRM — US Real Estate — $10/hr — 10 hrs/week. With $50 Bonus
description:
About the role:

We're a small US-based land wholesaling company. We send 1,500 outbound texts per day to landowners in the Southeast US, and we need an experienced VA to handle the next step in our funnel: discovery calls with sellers who reply, and accurate CRM updates after each call. This is a phone-heavy role, not a typing role.



Approximately 10 hours per week, Monday through Friday only (US federal holidays off), during US Central Time business hours (roughly 9am-4pm CT = 10pm-5am Manila). Pay is $10/hour paid weekly via Wise or PayPal, tracked through Time Doctor for the first 30-60 days. After the trial period and once trust is established, we may convert you to a flat weekly salary of $
/week with no time tracking. Performance bonuses available on top of base pay: $50 per closed deal that originated from your discovery call, with a path to graduated commission structures as you grow into the role over 6-12 months. 90-day trial-to-perm with potential to grow into a full-time acquisitions seat as our lead volume scales.



What you'll be doing:

You'll be making outbound discovery calls to landowners who have indicated interest via text. Each call is 15-30 minutes. Your job is to follow our discovery script, ask the qualifying questions, build rapport with the seller, and capture clean notes — NOT to make offers or close deals. Those calls go to the owner.

After each call, you'll update our CRM (Stride) with structured notes, set the next-action stage, schedule any callbacks, and flag motivated-seller signals for owner review. We provide an Otter.ai account for call recording and transcription — you don't need to bring your own. Every call must be recorded and uploaded so the owner can spot-check your work and coach you weekly.



Typical daily flow: 

2-3 hours, 5-10 outbound dial attempts per session, 4-8 connected discovery calls, 30 minutes of CRM updates and recording uploads after.

Requirements — please don't apply if you don't meet these



1+ year experience as an acquisitions or dispositions VA for a US real estate investor or wholesaler. Land experience is a strong plus; single-family residential is fine.



Fluent, clear English with minimal accent. Our sellers are rural southerners in Alabama, Tennessee, Kentucky — they'll hang up on anyone they have trouble understanding.

Per-package pricing (no video = no pay):

- $50 per video package

  - 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime)

  - 5–7 short-form vertical clips

  - 1 custom thumbnail



**Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):**

- $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries

- Based on quality, reliability, and communication



**Additional standalone shorts:**

- $5 each

- $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required



**Payment Schedule:**

- Every 2 weeks

- Only for packages actually delivered and approved



---



## About The Channel



This channel focuses on:



- mortgages

- real estate

- financial education

- wealth-building concepts



The editing style should feel:



- modern

- clean

- high-retention

- professional

- trustworthy



The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing.



We want viewers to feel:

*"Clear, calm, confident guidance."*



Style references:



- Graham Stephan

- Ali Abdaal

- Mark Tilbury



---



## What You'll Be Editing



You will primarily edit:



- talking-head educational videos

- financial storytelling content

- mortgage strategy content

- real-world buyer scenarios



Typical long-form videos:



- 5–10 minutes



You will also create:



- YouTube Shorts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok clips

- LinkedIn vertical clips



---



## Responsibilities



### Long-Form Editing



You will:



- remove mistakes, pauses, filler words

- tighten pacing for retention

- add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts

- add clean captions and text emphasis

- add occasional b-roll and overlays

- integrate provided infographics and visuals

- use light background music and subtle sound design

- maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style



### Short-Form Content



From each long-form video:



- identify strong hook moments

- create 5–7 vertical clips

- format properly for 9:16 platforms

- add captions and pacing optimized for retention

- create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video



**IMPORTANT:**

Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries.



### Thumbnails



You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video:



- clean, modern design

- clear focal point

- readable text at small sizes

- consistent with channel branding



### Visual / Graphics Work



You may occasionally:



- add simple motion graphics

- integrate charts and infographics

- use stock footage selectively

- organize visuals to improve understanding



Most visuals and scripts will be provided.



---



## Editing Style Requirements



We are looking for editors who understand:



- pacing

- storytelling rhythm

- educational retention

- visual clarity

- modern YouTube editing



This is NOT meme editing.



We prefer:



- clean cinematic pacing

- calm confidence

- modern documentary feel

- clarity over flashy effects



---



## NON-NEGOTIABLES



### Accuracy Matters



This is financial and mortgage content.



All:



- text

- numbers

- names

- graphics

- statistics



MUST match the spoken audio exactly.



Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit.



### Communication



We value:



- responsiveness

- reliability

- professionalism

- clear communication

- consistency



If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role.



### Turnaround Expectations



Typical turnaround:



- 24–48 hours for long-form edit

- Revisions handled quickly



---



## Workflow



Typical workflow:



1. Long-form video delivered first

2. Revisions completed

3. Shorts created from approved final video

4. Thumbnail finalized



We are building:



- templates

- SOPs

- editing systems

- reusable assets



Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow.



---



## Included Resources



You will usually receive:



- raw footage

- script

- topic context

- visual references

- infographic assets

- branding direction



---



## Required Skills



- YouTube editing

- Short-form editing

- CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Understanding of pacing and retention

- Good English comprehension

- Ability to follow detailed instructions

- Basic thumbnail design



Bonus:



- motion graphics

- advanced thumbnail design

- educational content editing

- storytelling instincts



---



## Important Notes



We are looking for:



- long-term relationship

- reliability

- someone who grows with the channel



This role may scale to:



- multiple videos per week

- additional responsibilities

- increased compensation over time based on consistency and quality



---



## Application Requirements



Please include:



1. 2–3 YouTube videos you edited

2. 2–3 short-form videos you edited

3. 1–2 thumbnail examples

4. Your editing software

5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video

6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail)

7. Your internet speed

8. Your 
 or WhatsApp



**IMPORTANT:**

Start your application message with the word:



**"EVEREST"**

## Auto-Disqualifiers



We will not consider applicants who:



- Don't include the word "EVEREST" at the start of their message

- Don't include portfolio examples

- Quote rates wildly outside our range without explanation

- Take more than 48 hours to respond during the application process

- test workflow

We value long-term consistency over short-term speed.

Salary: $900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance bonuses.







The Goal of This Role



If you are doing this job well, three things will be true about TopFoxx every single month:



Culture is strong. The team operates with accountability, urgency, professionalism, and respect. People who do not align with our core values are coached, corrected, or offboarded.

Everyone is high performing. Every department has clear KPIs, Rocks, and OKRs that are tracked, owned, and improving month over month.

Systems run the company. There are SOPs, scorecards, and Asana structures for everything, and every SOP has been personally tested by you to confirm a layman could follow it.

That is the job. Culture, performance, systems. Everything else supports those three outcomes.







About TopFoxx



TopFoxx is a rapidly growing, women-owned NYC e-commerce brand creating luxury eyewear with real solutions: floating sunglasses, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket sunnies, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small, ambitious, fast-moving team scaling quickly.



Our biggest opportunity right now is not product or marketing, it is culture, accountability, systems, and execution. We need someone who holds the standard daily, builds the structure that lets A-players thrive, and surfaces and offboards anyone not aligned with our core values.







Core Mission



Protect, reinforce, and operationalize our culture, standards, accountability, urgency, professionalism, and execution consistency. You are the holder of the standard, every day, across the whole company.



This is not a punishing role, it is a reinforcing and rewarding one. You catch people doing it right, praise them publicly, build incentives that reinforce the behaviors we want, and address misalignment quickly and directly. You are how we keep A-players happy and how we make sure we only have A-players.







The Stack You'll Run



You must be highly fluent in:



Asana (you are the guardian of Asana)

Slack (team communication and real-time culture monitoring)

Shopify (our e-commerce backbone)

Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom (documentation and SOPs)

AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, with the judgment to know the difference between a real, tested SOP and "AI slop" nobody can actually follow

We expect you to leverage AI to move faster, but to personally pressure-test every output before it ships.



EOS / Traction experience is highly preferred. You should already be fluent in Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10 meetings, and accountability rhythms.







Key Responsibilities



1. Culture and Accountability (The Main Job)



Be highly active in Slack, Asana, meetings, and team workflows, monitoring communication, behavior, professionalism, and collaboration.

Address issues immediately when standards are crossed. Pull people into quick 5-minute calls to correct behavior or clarify expectations.

Prevent negativity, gossip, blame-shifting, passive aggression, or poor communication from spreading culturally.

Catch and stop "AI slop" in the team's work, sloppy AI-generated outputs that have not been verified or thought through.

Document concrete, evidence-based examples of both positive and negative behavior tied to our core values. No vague feedback.

Use this documentation for coaching, promotions, reviews, warnings, and determining long-term fit.





2. Positive Reinforcement, Rewards, and Incentive Programs



Publicly recognize employees who demonstrate ownership, urgency, preparation, communication, and professionalism.

Run a steady cadence of small incentives (Amazon gift cards, shoutouts, peer recognition) for exceptional execution.

Design and run structured incentive and commission programs for revenue-driving roles (sales, wholesale, paid media, retention), tying rewards directly to outcomes that move the business.





3. KPI, Rocks, and OKR Ownership



You will not just tell people how they are doing, you will go in and check.



Shadow each department to understand what people actually do day to day.

Build KPI scorecards, quarterly Rocks, and OKRs for every department and role, with measurable weekly targets.

Run check-ins, identify bottlenecks, fix root causes, and improve KPIs month over month.

Our business is complicated with many moving parts. You will need to dig in to fully understand each role before setting standards for it.





4. Systems, SOPs, and Documentation (Quality-Controlled)



Build TopFoxx's operating backbone from the ground up: clear SOPs, step-by-step playbooks, and Loom videos for every recurring process.

Standardize folder structures, naming conventions, and templates in Google Drive.

Personally test every SOP. Walk through it yourself end to end as if you were a new hire. If a layman cannot follow it without asking questions, it is not done. No AI slop, no theoretical playbooks, no "close enough."

Re-test SOPs regularly. A stale SOP is worse than no SOP.





5. Coaching Leaders and Managers



Several people on our team are extremely talented in their craft but have never managed direct reports before. You will help build them into great managers.



Coach team leads on how to actually manage: setting expectations, giving direct feedback, running 1:1s, holding people accountable, and developing them.

Help managers raise the bar of the people they lead, not just delegate tasks.

Sit in on tough conversations and model what a direct, professional, accountable conversation looks like.

Identify when a manager is the bottleneck and coach them through it, or escalate to the Founder if the gap is too large.

Build a simple internal playbook for "how we manage at TopFoxx."





6. Onboarding, 1:1s, and Career Growth



You own how people are developed at TopFoxx, from day one through every stage of their career here.



Run onboarding for every new hire: be present every day for the first 5 days, then check in twice a week for the next few weeks, then settle into a weekly cadence.

Build a job scorecard for every role that defines what success looks like, what the KPIs are, and what "great" means at each level.

Build a career growth plan for every tea
mber that maps where they are now, where they could go, and what they need to develop to get there.

Hold weekly 1:1s with tea
mbers to check in on progress, blockers, wins, and growth.

Make development concrete, not theoretical. Every person should know exactly what they are working on, what they are being measured on, and what their next step looks like.





7. Asana and Project Management



Clean up and restructure workflows, create consistent naming conventions, and build repeatable project templates.

Ensure every task has clear ownership and a deadline.

Create tasks, follow-ups, reminders, and accountability checkpoints. Reinforce review timelines, urgency standards, and deadline ownership.





8. Interpersonal Conflict Resolution



Address tension, confusion, or recurring friction between tea
mbers early before it damages culture or performance.

Coach people toward direct, mature, solution-oriented communication.





9. Culture Presentations and Team Development



Create presentations, trainings, and workshops around our values and standards.

Continuously teach the team what "great" looks like operationally and behaviorally, reinforced through real examples and coaching.





10. Hiring, Vetting, and Talent Quality



Conduct structured interviews that test judgment, ownership, and real execution ability.

Check references thoroughly with hard, specific questions about reliability, speed, and integrity. Validate real past results, not buzzwords.

Assess cultural fit against TopFoxx values of accountability, urgency, and clarity.

Recommend final candidates to the Founder with clear, evidence-based rationale.





11. Operations Support and Role Backfill



While culture, KPIs, and systems are your main focus, you will also help where the business needs it, including temporarily stepping into vacated roles so things do not fall apart while we hire a replacement.



Be ready to absorb a vacated role short-term (customer service, ops support, project coordination).

Structure workflows across Customer Service, Fulfillment, and Vendors. Create checklists for inventory and orders.

Build Google Sheets trackers and handle general assistant tasks and project management for the Founder when required.





12. Reporting and Leadership Visibility



Provide leadership with recurring reports on:



Cultural health, team accountability, and communication quality.

Strong performers, team risks, operational bottlenecks, and alignment with core values.

KPI, Rock, and OKR progress across every department, month over month.

Manager development progress: who is growing into a strong leader, who is stuck.





What We're Looking For



5+ years in operations, project management, performance management, or systems building, with direct experience holding teams accountable and driving culture, not just managing tasks.

Experience coaching first-time managers into strong leaders.

Experience building KPI scorecards, Rocks, OKRs, and career growth plans that drove measurable improvement month over month.

Experience creating SOPs and playbooks that people actually use day to day.

Strong command of Asana, Slack, Shopify, Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom.

Strong AI fluency (Claude, ChatGPT) and judgment to know when an AI output is good vs "slop."

Excellent persuasive written and verbal English. You will be coaching, presenting, and writing for the whole team.

Comfortable having direct conversations when standards slip, without being harsh or political.

Startup or fast-growing small business experience preferred. E-commerce is a strong plus.

EOS / Traction experience (Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10s) is highly preferred since this is the system we are implementing.





What You Get



$900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance-based bonuses, based on experience.

Fully remote with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.

Direct access to the Founder and leadership team.

Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale.

Free TopFoxx products. Paid time off.

title: WordPress SEO Recovery, Site Migration & Ongoing Management
description:
Luxury Pool Builder - Dallas TX area



Who we are

A long time luxury custom pool builder in Frisco Texas. Small WordPress site (~50 pages, 25 blog posts, no e-commerce). Current consultant left a technical mess. We need one person to clean it up, migrate us to a clean independent setup, and manage ongoing SEO performance on a monthly retainer. Long-term relationship if you deliver.



The three phases — in order:

Phase 1 — Technical Fix (Week 1, one-time fixed price)

The site went invisible on Google around February 2026. Zero indexed pages. We know why. We need someone to confirm our diagnosis independently and fix it cleanly.

Specifically:



Look at fixes to previously broken page sitemap, make changes if needed.

Assess current needs for SEO, offer right away solutions and roadmap ideas

Resolve www vs non-www conflict

Clean redirect chain errors

Check and clear UnderConstruction plugin interference

Pull DreamHost server logs and confirm root cause

Block Pakistan bot spam traffic in GA4

Submit priority pages for re-indexing in GSC

Deliver one-page written summary of findings and fixes



Quote this as a fixed price. We expect this to take one experienced person less than a full day.

Phase 2 — Migration & Clean Setup (Week 2, one-time fixed price)

Separate the site completely from the previous consultant's shared agency workspace and move to a clean independent environment.



Specifically:



Transfer all credentials to client-owned accounts — GSC, GA4, WordPress admin, domain registrar, hosting

Assess current DreamHost shared hosting — recommend whether to migrate and to what host

Execute full WordPress migration if recommended — files, database, DNS, zero downtime

Set up clean isolated GA4 property under client-owned Google account

Set up dedicated GSC property verified under client-owned

Verify all redirects, sitemaps, and canonical tags survive migration correctly

Document everything with before and after screenshots



Quote this as a fixed price separate from Phase 1. For a small site with no e-commerce this should be straightforward.

Phase 3 — Ongoing Monthly Management (Retainer starting Month 2)

Small site, simple monthly scope. Client and/or content vendor will produce roughly two new pieces per month — city landing pages, blog posts, FAQ content. Your job is to make sure that content is technically sound, properly indexed, and performing.

Monthly deliverables:



GSC report by 5th of each month — indexed pages, crawl errors, impressions, clicks, top keyword positions

24-hour notification of any new crawl errors or indexing drops

On-page optimization of new content as published

Monthly competitive ranking snapshot vs three named DFW competitors

Quarterly technical audit — sitemaps, redirects, Core Web Vitals

All access held in client name always



What we need from you to apply:



Specific example of a Google indexing failure you diagnosed and fixed — what caused it, what you did, how long it took

Specific example of a WordPress site migration you managed — origin host, destination host, how you handled DNS cutover

Fixed price quote for Phase 1

Fixed price quote for Phase 2

Monthly retainer proposal for Phase 3 with exactly what it includes

Confirmation you manage all client properties in separate isolated Google accounts — not a shared agency workspace

Availability to begin Phase 1 this week



Generic proposals not considered. We have full documentation of the current situation and will ask specific technical questions before hiring.

Budget summary:

Phase 1: $150–$300 fixed

Phase 2: $150–$400 fixed

Phase 3: $??/month ongoing - its a minimal site.. Historically not much to do.



Total first month all-in: X?. Long-term retainer possible.

title: Data-Driven Social Media CRM & Marketing Operations Specialist (Direct Hire)
description:
Job Overview

Are you a systems-driven digital marketer who loves organizing chaos into clean data? Do you get excited about building workflows, tracking campaign performance, and ensuring no lead falls through the cracks? If you prefer analyzing spreadsheets and setting up CRM automations over just designing pretty graphics, we want you.

We are an expanding business looking for a high-level Marketing Operations & Social Media CRM Virtual Assistant. This is a long-term, direct-hire position (no agencies). You will own our data pipelines, making sure that every lead generated from our social media campaigns is organized, tracked, and ready to be used for our marketing growth.

Responsibilities

CRM & Database Management: Build and maintain our central source of truth (HubSpot/Airtable/Google Sheets) to track leads, audience demographics, and social media campaign performance.

Workflow Automation: Set up and manage automation bridges (Zapier/Make) to connect our social media platforms and DM automation tools (ManyChat) directly to our CRM.

Data Organization for Marketing: Segment our audience lists based on past behavior, engagement levels, and ad campaign source so we can use the data for retargeting and
 marketing.

Campaign Tracking & Analytics: Pull daily/weekly raw data from
 Ads Manager, TikTok, and organic channels. Clean up the data, organize it into dashboards, and provide insights on what is working.

Lead Cleanliness: Ensure data integrity by regularly deduplicating lists, fixing broken tracking links, and updating lead statuses.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

The Filter Word: To prove you pay attention to detail, you must start your application message with the phrase "Data-Driven Systems" in the subject line or first sentence. Applications without this will be deleted immediately.

Systems Experience: Proven experience setting up and managing CRMs (like HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or highly customized Airtable systems).

Automation Savvy: Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Zapier or Make.com (you know how to troubleshoot a broken webhook).

Social Funnel Knowledge: Familiarity with Meta Business Suite,
 Lead Forms, and DM automation tools like ManyChat.

Data Fluency: Advanced skills in Google Sheets/Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data sorting, and cleaning raw CSV files are second nature to you).

Reliability: A reliable workspace with a high-speed internet connection and a backup power solution.

What We Offer

Direct Hire Stability: Work directly with the business owner. No agency middlemen taking a cut of your pay.

Competitive Salary: [Insert Salary Range, e.g., $600 - $1,000 USD / Php 35,000 - Php 58,000] per month, depending on your actual technical experience.

Flexible/Consistent Hours: [Specify if it is full-time or part-time, and if it is fixed-shift or flexible hours].

Loyalty Bonus: We respect Filipino workplace traditions and offer a pro-rated 13th-month bonus in December for exceptional performance.

Growth Potential: As our data systems grow, your role and compensation have the room to grow into a Marketing Operations Manager position.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the perfect fit for your analytical mind, please apply with:

A brief summary of your experience managing CRMs and marketing data.

An example of an automation workflow or tracking dashboard you have built in the past (you can blur out sensitive client data).

A link to a 1-to-2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and telling us why you prefer marketing data over basic administrative tasks.

title: Remote Senior Nonprofit Bookkeeper
description:
About Us

We are a USA-based accounting and advisory firm dedicated exclusively to serving nonprofit organizations and mental health practices. We manage the complete accounting cycle for a portfolio of nonprofit clients simultaneously, delivering accurate, timely, and audit-ready financial records. Our clients trust us with the financial foundation of their missions. Every tea
mber we bring on is expected to perform at a professional level from day one, follow our documented systems, and take genuine ownership of their client portfolio.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to join our team. In this role, you will oversee comprehensive bookkeeping functions, ensuring accuracy and compliance across all financial records for a portfolio of nonprofit clients. You will work within our established systems and be held to firm-wide standards of accuracy and deadlines from day one.



This is not an entry-level role. You are expected to arrive with a fully developed competency in nonprofit accounting and the professional judgment to apply it independently across multiple clients in a remote environment.



Responsibilities

- Record and classify all transactions on an accrual basis with proper account coding, class tracking, and fund designation.

- Manage and maintain the general ledger in accordance with GAAP.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable: enter vendor bills, process payments, record invoices, and apply receipts accurately.

- Prepare and post all month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepaid amortization, depreciation, and deferred revenue schedules.

- Conduct balance sheet reconciliation and review financial statements for discrepancies or errors.

- Record payroll allocation entries across cost centers, grants, and functional expense categories.

- Track restricted grants, donor contributions, and program expenses in compliance with nonprofit accounting standards.

- Produce and deliver month-end financial statements for management review.

- Support the Form 990 and audit preparation process by maintaining clean, organized records and preparing schedules as requested.

- Maintain meticulous records of journal entries, account analyses, and audit documentation to ensure audit readiness.

- Utilize accounting software, including QuickBooks Online and Xero, to manage bookkeeping operations.

- Identify opportunities to automate financial processes and increase efficiency.

- Deliver clear, accurate financial reports for internal review, client communication, and external audits.



Qualifications

 - Minimum 5 years of nonprofit accounting experience with demonstrated ability to apply accrual accounting, fund accounting, net asset classifications under ASU
, grant tracking, and functional expense allocation independently and without supervision.

 - Demonstrated ability to apply ASC 606 and ASC 842 standards, specifically managing revenue recognition based on grant documents, funder restrictions, and milestones.

- Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously in an outsourced accounting firm or agency setting.

- Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO), Xero, Sage, and other financial management tools.

- Advanced proficiency in project and work management tools such as Asana, Gmail, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, 
, Ramp, and similar platforms.

- Deep understanding of GAAP, double-entry bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, and general ledger reconciliation.

- Familiarity with governmental accounting practices and tax experience is highly desirable.

- Excellent knowledge of financial concepts, including account analysis, account reconciliation, debits and credits, journal entries, and balance sheet management.

- Ability to context-shift between multiple clients and thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills to interpret complex financial data accurately.

- Effective written communication skills for financial reporting and client correspondence.

- High integrity, accountability, and respect for client confidentiality.

- Minimum 12 consecutive months of fully remote, self-directed work with independent deadline management.

- Problem-solving mentality with a proactive approach to process improvement and continuous learning.



Schedule and Compensation

- Part-time: 15 hours per week, with required availability between 8:00 AM and 3:00 PM EST // 9 pm and 2 am Philippines time. Hours are expected to increase to full-time as performance benchmarks are met, and the client portfolio grows

- Compensation details: $8 per hour for a trial period (1-3 months) and $10 per hour (post-trial period) 



To Apply: To be considered for this position, your application must include the following, submitted together in a single
:

 - Your resume

 - A brief message describing your experience with nonprofit fund accounting and at least one outsourced or multi-client accounting environment you have supported

- The answer to the following question, included at the top of your message: "What is the net asset classification framework introduced under ASU
, and how does it differ from the previous two-category model?"



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Receptionist VA (Remote) | Fast Hiring – 24-Hour Review
description:
